'''Fen Corandel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Corandel was hiding in the [[Geonosian Bio-Lab]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], only to later be [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agent sent by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:FenCorandel.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Fen Corandel, including a female depiction deemed non-canon in ''Legends'']]
Fen Corandel was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ItDotDS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Fen Corandel was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:ItDotDS" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref> As with [[Raphael Mar-Shayal]], Fen Corandel's appearance was randomly generated. Corandel's appearance could range from a [[Gender/Legends|male]] or female [[Human/Legends|Human]], to a male [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]].
